description: This file contains the implementation of a default options formatter for the Orleans framework, including classes for formatting options objects and resolving formatters based on options monitor.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>
classes.description: Implements IOptionFormatter<T> to format options of type T into string representations, with support for redacting and handling collections.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsFormatterResolver<T>
classes.description: Resolves instances of IOptionFormatter<T> using an IOptionsMonitor<T> to retrieve options by name.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.DefaultOptionsFormatter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formatter with options obtained from IOptions<T>.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.DefaultOptionsFormatter
methods.description: Internal constructor that initializes the formatter with a specific options name and options instance.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.Format
methods.description: Formats the properties of the options object into a sequence of strings.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.Resolve
methods.description: Resolves an IOptionFormatter<T> for a given name using the options monitor.
